_meta.purpose: Single source of truth for Claude model roster + task-tier -> model mapping used when dispatching subagents. agent-delegation.md's model table points here.
_meta.authoritative_availability_source: The Claude Desktop model selector (bottom-right of the app) is the ground truth for which models are AVAILABLE right now. The Agent/Workflow tool `model` enum lists dispatchable ALIASES but does NOT reflect live availability (e.g. fable is a valid alias yet currently unavailable). When reconciling, trust the desktop selector for availability.

subagent_policy._owner_directive_2026_07_01: Main loop = opus (fixed). Subagents choose between sonnet and opus by task complexity/difficulty — a two-way pick, NOT the old 4-tier ladder. haiku is NOT in the default rotation. fable is unavailable; re-evaluate (top tier for long-horizon autonomous work) if/when it reopens.

opus.when: high difficulty — research experiment design, methodology decisions, high-risk paper judgment, paper-body / research-honesty verification, anything where precision & domain expertise matter

sonnet.when: medium/low difficulty — structured/procedural work: platform ops, FB/feed posting, paper-update runs, browser automation, verification/merge/publication-scan checklists, large search, lookup

haiku.status: available but OFF the default rotation per owner directive; only consider for truly trivial bulk lookups if ever, else use sonnet

fable.status: UNAVAILABLE now; when it reopens, re-evaluate as the top tier for ambitious long-horizon autonomous work (multi-day agentic, large migrations, deep multi-stage research)

rules: Respect skill frontmatter model default first; override via Agent tool `model` param only when skill has none or the task clearly escalates.
Subagent model is a sonnet<->opus pick by difficulty (owner directive 2026-07-01). NEVER downgrade high-risk research/statistics/paper judgment below opus.
Do NOT inline procedural side-tasks (browser automation, scans, large search) on the opus main loop — fork a SONNET subagent (context: fork). 2026-07-01 gap: FB posting ran inline on opus.
Do NOT route to a model whose available=false (e.g. fable now).
